{{Quote|Lieutenant Gundo, Eighty-sixth Infantry. You're here just in time. We've got Imperial forces massing outside.|Lieutenant Gundo|<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />}}
'''Gundo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Republic Army]]'s [[Eighty-sixth Infantry]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. By [[3642 BBY]], Gundo was stationed at a [[Adrenal Research Base|research facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] alongside the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and former [[Dark Council]] member [[Sajar]]. When Quesh was [[Quesh war|invaded]] and the facility attacked by Imperial forces, Gundo led his detachment in the defense of the facility, with the help of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]], to prevent the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] from capturing Sajar.

==Biography==
{{Quote|My engineers jury-rigged some ray shields, but it'll take time to seal the base. Unless you people hold the main entrance, we're dead.|Lieutenant Gundo explains the situation to the Knight|<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]], Gundo had enlisted in the [[Republic Army]] and risen to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Eighty-sixth Infantry]]<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3642 BBY]].<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Gundo was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]], where his detachment guarded a [[Adrenal Research Base|Republic research facility]] that studied Quesh's environment in hopes of improving the planet's production of [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenals]]. Gundo's men were joined by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Sajar]], who had been a member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] ruling [[Dark Council]] in the [[Great Galactic War|previous war]] before he was convinced to abandon the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]]. Braga had sent his Padawan to the relatively peaceful Quesh so that the [[Human/Legends|Human]] could [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] while still serving the Republic, but Quesh was [[Quesh war|invaded]] by the Empire<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> in 3642 BBY.<ref name="Annihilation" />

[[File:Adrenal_Research_Facility_In.png|thumb|left|170px|The Adrenal Research Facility]]
Gundo's men captured several Imperial [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] while defending the facility, and the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] were brought to Sajar for interrogation. However, Sajar succumbed to anger and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the prisoners, and the Padawan lied to Gundo about his hand in their deaths when asked. But some of the Imperial forces located the research facility and approached the base, causing Sajar to confront their [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Quesh)|commander]] and [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] hurl the bodies at the enemy. The Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]] recognized Sajar and warned the former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] that the [[Emperor's Wrath]] was coming for him&mdash;the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] personal executioner, Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]]. To Gundo's dismay, Sajar retreated and refused to fight the enemy for fear of returning to the dark side, and the Lieutenant was forced to prepare the base for attack himself.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

At Gundo's orders, the Eighty-sixth's [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] jury-rigged several [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]] that could seal the base, but there was not enough [[Time/Legends|time]] to set up the devices. While his engineers scrambled to set up the defenses, Gundo was relieved when a second Jedi arrived&mdash;the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]], who had been sent by Sajar's Master to investigate after Sajar stopped answering Braga's communications. The Hero and a companion spoke to the Padawan and learned the reasoning behind Sajar's reluctance to fight or speak with Braga, but Gundo interrupted the Jedi's conversation with news on the base's situation. Informing the Hero about the defenses, the Lieutenant asked for both the Knight and Sajar's help in defending the main entrance so that his engineers could finish setting up the ray [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]].<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
[[File:Gundo_computers.png|thumb|right|190px|Gundo activates the shields.]]
Deciding not to risk the possibility of Sajar falling to the dark side, the Hero ordered the former Sith to help the engineers in setting up the ray shields, and the Knight and a companion rushed to the defense of the facility. As the pair steadily fought their way back to the main entrance and eliminated the Imperial attackers in their path, Gundo secured the other entrances with his men before rushing to aid the Jedi. Just as the Lieutenant reached the main entrance with the Hero, he was alerted by his engineers that the ray shields were ready, and Gundo immediately activated them from a nearby console. Excited by their victory, Gundo assured the Knight that his unit would be able to hold out until reinforcements arrived&mdash;but he was interrupted by motion outside the shield.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />
{{Endgame}}

To both Gundo and the Knight's surprise, a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]]&mdash;the Emperor's Wrath&mdash;approached the shield and exchanged several cryptic comments with the Hero before departing. Relieved that the threat had ended for now, Gundo thanked the Knight and reported that, according to his engineers, Sajar's help had allowed them to get the ray shields up in half the time. The Lieutenant remained at his post near the entrance while the Knight went to speak with Sajar, and he continued to guard the research facility with the rest of the Eighty-sixth Infantry detachment even after Sajar departed to the Jedi [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] to meet with his Master about his brush with the dark side.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We're out of time&mdash;Imperials are coming through! Defend the main entrance!|Gundo commands his troops in battle|<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />}}
[[File:Gundo.png|thumb|left|150px|Lieutenant Gundo]]
An olive-skinned Mirialan male with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], pink [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and black facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]],<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> Gundo was one of many members of his [[Species/Legends|species]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] in the aftermath of the Great Galactic War.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Gundo was a calm [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] and a competent commander in battle, and when the situation was tense he did not waste words. When the Hero of Tython arrived during the fighting, Gundo took the Knight's entrance in stride and immediately treated the Jedi as another strategic asset&mdash;asking the Hero to help defend the main entrance without even questioning the stranger's identity.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

==Equipment==
As a member of the Eighty-sixth Infantry, Gundo wore white and grey [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with gold markings and a [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] on his left shoulder. He also carried a standard-issue [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], though he chose to forgo a helmet in combat.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gundo first appeared in the Jedi Knight mission "The Emperor's Wrath" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]. The mission features one major alignment choice: what to allow Sajar to do during the battle. The player will gain dark-side points if they force Sajar to fight, as his fall to the dark side will accelerate while fighting, but they gain light-side points if they tell him to stay behind or to help the engineers.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />
